title: Gold occurrences near Jefferson, South Carolina
citation: Minard, J.P., 1971, Gold occurrences near Jefferson, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Bulletin 1334, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: USGS Bulletin 1334 (Minard, 1971), gold occurrences near Jefferson, Chesterfield County; plate 1 at 1:24,000, geology mapped 1967-68. Map symbols, alluvium/intermixed/argillite names and age brackets read from the plate image. Gold assays (ppm) kept in outcrop and auger-hole descriptions; table 1 panned stream-sediment particle counts not itemized; table 3 auger-hole rows are scrambled in the text layer, so only holes described in the text are recorded. Kinkel pit assays (p. 16) not itemized. Brewer lode recorded as 'other' structure. SUBSURFACE: Coastal Plain cover 35-40 ft over saprolite at auger holes 2 and 5.
